name: regression-commit-history
goal: Commit the failing regression test before the fix, and show both exact results in Harness history

evidence: Persist the failing-test commit and separate fix commit; compare unchanged tests and commands; expose exact results and links in shared app history.

Existing loop tests accept free-text proof on an uncommitted checkout. They never require separate Git commits, immutable test hashes or app links. Extend that standardized CLI fixture and shared evidence browser fixture.

On ac6c026c with only standardized coverage changes, CLI red/green contract cases fail because committed proof is absent; 9 failures, 4 passing checks. The browser fails because Regression proof is absent. Logs: /tmp/harness-regression-commits-red.log and /tmp/harness-regression-history-ui-red.log; screenshot: /tmp/harness-regression-before.png. Product source is unchanged.
